name: life-sim-dev-team
description: A multi-role Spec Coding delivery team for the AI Life Simulator repository, covering requirements, architecture, simulation core, frontend and QA acceptance.

displayDescription.en: Runs Spec Coding iterations for the AI Life Simulator, with a lead coordinating requirements, architecture, simulation core, frontend and QA before any code change.
displayDescription.zh: 按规格设计任务实施四段式推进人生模拟器迭代，团长统筹需求、架构、内核、前端与测试，先审查对齐再改码。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 按 R2 迭代包推进阶段 0 差距复核，输出 45 条 ACTIVE 需求的五态标注报告，不改实现代码。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Review the R2 gap analysis: classify all 45 ACTIVE requirements into five states without changing implementation code.

quickPrompts.zh: 按 R2 迭代包推进阶段 0 差距复核，输出 45 条 ACTIVE 需求的五态标注报告，不改实现代码。
quickPrompts.en: Review the R2 gap analysis: classify all 45 ACTIVE requirements into five states without changing implementation code.

quickPrompts.zh: 为下一轮迭代起草 requirements、design、tasks 四件套，保留 DEFERRED 需求编号与原文。
quickPrompts.en: Draft the next iteration package of requirements, design and tasks while preserving DEFERRED item IDs and original text.

quickPrompts.zh: 实施 tasks.md 里指定的一个任务，按完成定义自验，并用 AGENTS.md 第 4 节格式汇报。
quickPrompts.en: Implement one specified task from tasks.md, self-verify against its definition of done, and report in the AGENTS.md section 4 format.
